newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian RTS share index up one pct to record close.
newsitem.headline: Russian RTS share index up one pct to record close.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 22-share index rose one percent on Monday to a record close of 366.22 on a healthy volume of $40.8 million, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
The index set an all-time record of 366.80 at 1200 GMT, NAUFOR data showed.
It closed on Friday at 362.52, the previous record, on $68.8 million turnover. The index was below 200 at the end of last year.
